description: Browse and query logs from Oakestra Root, Cluster, and 1-DOC orchestrator components.

options.content:
- **Cluster** selects the indexed `cluster_id` of the orchestrator that emitted the record: `root` or a configured Cluster name. It supports multi-select and **All**; `context.cluster_id` is only a business value inside an application record.
- **Source** groups containers into **Oakestra services** (default), **Observability**, **Data stores**, or **All containers**. It filters the Component choices and keeps infrastructure noise out of normal application browsing.
- **Component** selects one or more indexed Docker Compose services within the chosen Cluster and Source; **All** keeps every matching service.
- **Level** filters Alloy's normalized Loki `level` label exactly. **Critical** is separate from **Error**. Only schema-v1 Python headers whose service identity matches the emitting Compose service, plus service-scoped compatibility formats may set this label; words inside `logger`, `message`, `event`, or `context` cannot change severity.
- **Unparsed** shows records whose format has no recognized level. Grafana's text highlighting or inferred color is visual only and does not change the authoritative Loki label.
- **Display = Compact** turns each schema-v1 JSON record into `[component] message`, followed only by its event, context, and exception summary when present. **Raw** restores the exact stored line. Non-schema records remain readable raw text with a component prefix in Compact mode.
- **Full-line search (regex)** intentionally matches the complete raw record before display formatting, including message and structured fields. Use it for free text or shared IDs. Highlighting a word such as `ERROR` does not classify the record as Error.
- **Advanced field filter (LogQL)** parses high-cardinality fields at query time before display formatting. Exact schema-v1 examples: `| json schema="schema_version", event_name="event" | schema="1" | event_name="cluster.registration.completed"`, `| json schema="schema_version", logger_name="logger" | schema="1" | logger_name="werkzeug"`, or `| json schema="schema_version", job_id="context.job_id" | schema="1" | job_id="<id>"`. Aliases avoid collisions with stream labels.
- `| logfmt` in this field is an optional query-time parser, not Oakestra's Python format. It does not create the Level label; Alloy has already normalized that label during ingestion. Select **Source = Observability** and choose a local observability component that emits logfmt first; then try `| logfmt duration_value="duration" | duration_value > 1ms | __error__=""`.
- Repeated stream labels are hidden and details open in a sidebar. Expand a line for labels and derived links, or select **Raw** to inspect the complete record. The left timestamp is Loki's entry time in the browser timezone; schema-v1 `timestamp` is the application time in UTC.
- **Shared-ID links** are correlation shortcuts, not distributed traces. Expand a line containing a 24-character Oakestra ID and choose **Search this ID...** to keep the time range, reset Level, place the ID in Full-line search, and query another component. A target can return no result when it did not log the same ID.
- **Time range (maximum 30 days):** The generic Grafana picker may show longer ranges, but Loki 2.9 rejects a single query longer than `30d1h`. To inspect older retained history, use an absolute window no wider than 30 days and move that window backward.
- Open the logs panel menu and choose **Explore** to edit the complete LogQL query.

panels.description: LogQL selector and pipeline are built from the dashboard controls. Use the panel menu to open this query in Explore.

targets.expr: {cluster_id=~"${cluster_id:regex}", compose_service=~"${source_scope:raw}", compose_service=~"${compose_service:regex}", level=~"${level_filter:raw}"} |~ `(?i)(${search:raw})` ${logql_pipeline:raw} | line_format `{{ if eq "${display_mode:raw}" "compact" }}[{{ .compose_service }}] {{ with $record := fromJson (__line__) }}{{ if and (eq (printf "%v" $record.schema_version) "1") $record.timestamp $record.level $record.service $record.logger }}{{ $record.message }}{{ with $record.event }} · event={{ . }}{{ end }}{{ with $record.context }}{{ range $key, $value := . }} · {{ $key }}={{ printf "%v" $value }}{{ end }}{{ end }}{{ with $record.exception }} · exception={{ .type }}{{ with .message }}: {{ . }}{{ end }}{{ end }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}{{ else }}{{ __line__ }}{{ end }}`

panels.title: Selected logs — ${source_scope:text} · ${cluster_id:text} / ${compose_service:text} · ${display_mode:text}

list.description: Origin orchestrator from the indexed cluster_id label: Root or the configured CLUSTER_NAME. Supports multi-select and All.
list.label: Cluster
list.name: cluster_id

list.description: Container category and first-stage filter. It also limits the Component choices; Oakestra services is the quiet default.
list.label: Source
list.name: source_scope
list.query: Oakestra services : ^(system_manager|root_scheduler|root_resource_abstractor|resource_abstractor|root_service_manager|jwt_generator|dashboard|marketplace_manager|root_addons_dashboard|root_addons_manager|root_addons_monitor|addons_dashboard|addons_manager|addons_monitor|cluster_manager|cluster_scheduler|cluster_resource_abstractor|cluster_service_manager|cluster_addons_dashboard|cluster_addons_manager|cluster_addons_monitor|mqtt)$, Observability : ^(alloy|grafana|loki|cluster_alloy|cluster_grafana|cluster_loki|prometheus)$, Data stores : ^(mongo_root|mongo_rootnet|root_redis|redis|mongo_cluster|mongo_clusternet|cluster_redis)$, All containers : .+

list.description: Docker Compose service or services available for the selected Cluster and Source. Supports multi-select and All.
list.label: Component
list.name: compose_service

list.description: Exact normalized Loki severity. All includes parsed and unparsed records; Unparsed selects only records without a level label.
list.label: Level
list.name: level_filter
list.query: All : .*, Debug : debug, Info : info, Warning : warning, Error : error, Critical : critical, Unparsed : ^$

list.description: Compact formats schema-v1 JSON as a readable summary; Raw shows the exact stored line.
list.label: Display
list.name: display_mode

list.description: Case-insensitive RE2 expression matched against the complete raw record; the default ^ matches every line.
list.label: Full-line search (regex)
list.name: search

list.description: Appended after the indexed and full-line filters for exact query-time fields, for example | json schema="schema_version", event_name="event" | schema="1" | event_name="cluster.registration.completed".
list.label: Advanced field filter (LogQL)
list.name: logql_pipeline
